rule: Background 7 with one single-colour, doubly-symmetric 3x3 symbol. The output is a fixed 16x16 lattice. Indices that are 0 mod 3 are lines (L) and all others are blocks (B). LL/LB/BL/BB take 0 if the symbol's centre/middle-left/top-middle/corner cell is filled, otherwise 7. Every 0 in rows 5..10 and columns 5..10 then becomes 9.
scope: Supported: all 10 doubly-symmetric symbols with a full 3x3 bounding box, any symbol position, symbol colours 1-6 and 8, and input sides 5..30. Random sides are 5..10, with 6x6 favoured; anything other than 6x6 is a synthetic extension. Optional attested_only=True restricts sampling to the fixture-attested family (top != corner). Not supported: asymmetric symbols, multiple symbols, other background colours, and output sizes other than 16x16. The task fixes those, and the reference reads only four symbol cells.
constraints: Independent four-bit symbol-to-lattice renderer agrees on 100 fresh cases

The symbol is mirror-symmetric horizontally and vertically, so the four controlling cells define it unambiguously.
The symbol colour is never 0, 7 or 9, so it cannot collide with the background or the output palette.

The output is always 16x16 and differs from the input, so no sample is an identity mapping.
